queries_run: EMCOR Group largest customer concentration second source OR in-house 2026

findings.claim: EMCOR 10-K 風險因素揭露：可能面臨現有或潛在客戶自有 in-house 服務組織的競爭（尤其 building services），不確定客戶未來會否繼續外包。屬一般性風險，未指名最大客戶導入第二供應商。
findings.excerpt: We may also face competition from the in-house service organizations of existing or prospective customers, particularly with respect to building services. Many of our customers employ personnel who perform some of the same types of building services that we do.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未發現最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的具體事件。
